action: Proposed replacement of fixed equal mean of channel-wise SPATIAL correlations by one regularized learned identity score, with the same learned no-FlyVis input controls. This gate decides whether a causal directly labeled training population exists; it does not fit the head.
population: Reuse ALL stored direct-reference candidate records from the previous84-video metadata inventory, not only exactly one-own/one-foreign clean pairs. Exclude all15 videos used to inspect the new relative reader. Each known candidate is an isolated input; unknown GT stays unknown.
causal_reference: Separate STRICT_LAST (reference_index==ep_offset+3, actual last observed warm frame directly annotated) from EARLIER_LABELLED (earlier actual annotation selected offline). Never pool the latter into the deployment-ready training claim. Require two distinct input timestamps; same four-observation warm-prefix clock.
geometry: All reference STATE-box cells, one candidate-specific observed-box affine transform, original19 physical-pixel offsets and hull. Same minimum3cells, no other candidate used to select support. This is a NEW isolated-candidate geometry, not repeat of ready two-candidate support counts.
labels: Independently verify every reference against native row by exact float32 confidence/class/frame -> unique raw detection -> unique noncrowd car GTIoU>=.5; independently verify every known current raw box and unique GT. Labels only measure same/different object. No interpolated GT, no model inference, no fr_hex decompression.
dedup: Unique video/reference_frame/current_frame/old_tid/raw_detection; firstUID frozen order. Current public owner is context only and not a training feature or eligibility rule.
readiness: STRICT_LAST has both own and foreign labels in every leave-one-video-out training fold. This is only mathematical trainability of a binary head with an unpenalized intercept, not a sample-size or generalization guarantee. Missing retinal array stops readiness. No relaxation after outcome.
next: Only on readiness: separately freeze per-channel feature restoration, fixed ridge-logistic objective/settings, video-separated evaluation and identical controls. At most two further diagnostics, then full native-ID intervention check or stop this version. No thresholds on the15inspected videos, no automatic expensive core training.

acceptance.criterion: Every retained label independently verified, sources unchanged, all exclusions/unknowns/cohorts retained; no fr_hex/model/score/tracker work.
Both classes remain in every strict-last leave-one-video training fold with saved retinal input.
